name: Guilloché Security Print
description: Banknote-grade lathe work: hairline hypotrochoid rosettes and woven sine-ring meshes in split-fountain iris inks on fibred security paper, with engraved serif lettering, microtext and red serials.
motionNotes: Motion: Like a geometric lathe plotting the plate: the underprint waves and border ropes trace on, each rosette band is drawn pen-pass by pen-pass, the engraved title is wiped in, the red serials are stamped digit by digit; then the meshes slowly counter-rotate into shimmering moiré and a light glint crosses the note.
explainerNotes: Explainer: A sheet of five security-printed notes the camera pans across; the model is a lathe rosette whose passes start out of register and are brought into register by each correction, with engraved double-rule arrows, red numbering-machine counters and rubber cancellation stamps for WRONG / VERIFIED / CERTIFIED.
